releaseNotes:
- Added Upward mode
- Added compression curve visualizer
- Added Range to limit maximum gain reduction
- Added Lookahead for better transient detection
- Added sidechain link mode (Mid or Max)
- Sidechain EQ: drag handles, mouse wheel for Q and slope
- Waveform zoom is now saved between sessions
- Added low graphics mode for low-end systems
- Improved graphics and performance
